thread:
Sam R: FYI — candidate for SDE2 (EU) got a counteroffer, wants to move start up 2 weeks and asked if we can bridge to the higher band until comp review. Need quick decision, they're asking by EOD.
Anya (People Ops): who's the candidate/team? can you paste the current offer terms (redact PII) and the counter?
Sam R: team: infra-obs. Offer: base €115k + 10% target bonus, band says SDE2 top = €120k. Counteroffer is €130k. Candidate wants start 2026-04-06 instead of planned 2026-04-20.
Maria (Comp): looks like requested > band cap. We can do a provisional bridge stipend or a one-time sign-on to match economic comp while formal band uplift goes through. Need hiring mgr justification and VP approval for exception.
Leo H: I'm comfortable signing off on the business case — critical hire for rollout. Can we do a 3-month bridge stipend of €5k/month plus moving start earlier? I can commit budget.
Anya (People Ops): @Maria (Comp) quick Q: policy says sign-on + provisional uplift allowed but must be timeboxed <90 days and final band decision within 60 days. Can offerbot check routing required approvers?
offer-bot: Automated check: "Requested action: provisional stipend + start date change. Required approvals: Comp team + Recruiting Dir or VP + Finance sign-off. Routing: comp@, vp-engi@. Deadline constraints: candidate response by EOD"
Maria (Comp): OK, route to VP for approved provisional uplift limited to 90 days; require written commit from Leo for review timeline. Finance approver added. I'll draft the exception memo.
Sam R: I'll ping VP and attach the redacted counter email. Leo will send commit. Can we offer provisional stipend and confirm earlier start pending approvals? candidate needs answer for relocation timeline.
Anya (People Ops): let's do provisional offer: keep base €115k, add 3-month bridge stipend €5k/mo paid as lump on first payroll, start 2026-04-06. Condition: stipend paid only if candidate starts; final comp review complete by 2026-06-15 or stipend clawback. I'll prepare language and send to legal + comp for sign-off.
Leo H: sending commit now to VP. I can expedite the review.
Maria (Comp): drafting memo. tagging @vp-engi. If VP approves, People Ops to issue updated offer.
Sam R: Thanks team — will update candidate that we're preparing an expedited provisional approval and should have final answer tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Anya (People Ops): noted, logging thread to the offer exceptions tracker: link to internal doc (redacted).
